# Fracturize regression fixture

`FracturizeRegression.ufo` is original synthetic test data generated by
`scripts/build_regression_fixture.py`. It is safe to redistribute with this
repository and may be regenerated rather than edited by hand.

The fixture covers multiply-wound overlap normalization, cubic flattening,
counters, components, metadata, kerning, groups, features, guidelines, a
background layer, and UFO data files. It contains no production font outlines.
